bullets.title: Inktober
bullets.note: Created in 2009 by [Jake Parker](https://el2.convertkit-mail.com/c/5qu8lqg33u7hm460qf0/gwfnh5hnmmp8nx/aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cubXJqYWtlcGFya2VyLmNvbS8=) ([@jakeparker](https://el2.convertkit-mail.com/c/5qu8lqg33u7hm460qf0/33tphkhr33z5rx/aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuaW5zdGFncmFtLmNvbS9qYWtlcGFya2VyLw==)), Inktober is a simple challenge: every October, artists all over the world take on the “Inktober drawing challenge” by doing one ink drawing a day for the entire month. You can [find the rules here](https://el2.convertkit-mail.com/c/5qu8lqg33u7hm460qf0/4mcvheh9mmgd9v/aHR0cHM6Ly9pbmt0b2Jlci5jb20vcnVsZXM=). [Here are this year’s drawing prompts (so good)](https://el2.convertkit-mail.com/c/5qu8lqg33u7hm460qf0/r4s8hoh7mmxl7d/aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuaW5zdGFncmFtLmNvbS9wL0IxMzhoUlNnNU5HLw==). If you end up participating and the spirit moves you, please tag me on social ([@timferriss on Instagram](https://el2.convertkit-mail.com/c/5qu8lqg33u7hm460qf0/82aqhoh3oo963n/aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuaW5zdGFncmFtLmNvbS90aW1mZXJyaXNzLw==) and [@tferriss on Twitter](https://el2.convertkit-mail.com/c/5qu8lqg33u7hm460qf0/lqbehmh4llrm49/aHR0cDovL3R3aXR0ZXIuY29tL3RmZXJyaXNz)), as I’d love to see your work. Since I’m getting a late start myself, I have some catching up to do! I might end up using [a Buddha Board](https://el2.convertkit-mail.com/c/5qu8lqg33u7hm460qf0/dkheh0hkee59k9/aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuYW1hem9uLmNvbS9PcmlnaW5hbC1CdWRkaGEtQm9hcmQtUmVsYXhpbmctUGFpbnRpbmcvZHAvQjAwMTBURUZGUQ==) instead of ink to avoid getting too precious...

bullets.title: 50 ways to be ridiculously generous — and feel ridiculously good
bullets.creator: Alexandra Franzen
bullets.note:
. This is a great list, which I found recommended on the website of fellow Austinite [Professor Raj Raghunathan](https://el2.convertkit-mail.com/c/5qu8lqg33u7hm460qf0/x9fph6hzee3vz4/aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuaGFwcHlzbWFydHMuY29tLw==), author of [_If You’re So Smart, Why Aren’t You Happy?_](https://el2.convertkit-mail.com/c/5qu8lqg33u7hm460qf0/kotmh6hennm0ep/aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuYW1hem9uLmNvbS9Zb3VyZS1TbWFydC1XaHktQXJlbnQtSGFwcHkvZHAvMTEwMTk4MDczNw==). If overwhelmed by options, try this: give an extra $10 or $20 to the barista next time you buy coffee. Give $5 of that to the barista and pay for the next person or next few people behind you. Simply walk out after the drive-by karma bomb. The afterglow is incredible and can last hours. Paradoxically, the fastest path to feeling better is often this type of indirect route, and it makes me think of this quote sometimes attributed to Henry David Thoreau: “Happiness is like a butterfly: the more you chase it, the more it will evade you, but if you notice the other things around you, it will gently come and sit on your shoulder.”

**What I’m watching** —[**This could be why you’re depressed or anxious**](https://el2.convertkit-mail.com/c/5qu8lqg33u7hm460qf0/24c2hohg33dpg5/aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cudGVkLmNvbS90YWxrcy9qb2hhbm5faGFyaV90aGlzX2NvdWxkX2JlX3doeV95b3VfcmVfZGVwcmVzc2VkX2FuZF9hbnhpb3VzI3QtMjYzODcy) (TED Talk) by [Johann Hari](https://el2.convertkit-mail.com/c/5qu8lqg33u7hm460qf0/g5snh5hnmmp8o7/aHR0cHM6Ly8yMDE4LmpvaGFubmhhcmkuY29tLw==) ([@johannhari101](https://el2.convertkit-mail.com/c/5qu8lqg33u7hm460qf0/39aphkhr33z59o/aHR0cHM6Ly90d2l0dGVyLmNvbS9qb2hhbm5oYXJpMTAx)). I’ve become more and more interested in the work and life experiences of Johann since a friend gifted me his book [_Lost Connections: Uncovering the Real Causes of Depression – and the Unexpected Solutions_](https://el2.convertkit-mail.com/c/5qu8lqg33u7hm460qf0/4dbvheh9mmgdqp/aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuYW1hem9uLmNvbS9Mb3N0LUNvbm5lY3Rpb25zLVVuY292ZXJpbmctRGVwcmVzc2lvbi1VbmV4cGVjdGVkLWVib29rL2RwL0IwNzU4M1hKUlc=). In this new talk, he shares fresh insights on the causes of depression and anxiety from experts around the world as well as his personal experiences and emerging solutions. As Johann puts it, “If you’re depressed or anxious, you’re not weak and you’re not crazy—you’re a human being with unmet needs.” This is a much needed reframe.
